description: The ZAHA research team at Technical University of Munich publishes a benchmark of facade point clouds with a Level of Facade Generalization hierarchy. Repository documentation reports 601 million annotated points, varying architectural styles and local and global UTM coordinate representations. File names identify corresponding official Bavarian CityGML LoD2 building objects, connecting measured facade detail to city-model geometry. TUM2TWIN lists ZAHA among its mobile laser-scanning resources for the campus environment in Munich, Germany. The public repository links dataset storage and describes settings for adding observations. Documentation is free to read; dataset access conditions and a dataset-specific reuse licence were not established. Complete file formats and acquisition dates remain uncertain. Caveats include the provider's 45.66-metre vertical-offset guidance when reconciling height systems and the need to preserve building identities during conversion. These observations support detailed building reconstruction and digital-twin preparation. The related TUM-FAÇADE resource has a different annotation scope and remains separate. Algorithm performance tables were omitted from the maintained evidence. No point clouds, images or code files were obtained.
